# Third-party marks (not ours, do not edit)

- `google_g.png`: Google's "G" mark for the "Continue with Google" button. It comes from Google's official sign-in assets (https://developers.google.com/static/identity/images/signin-assets.zip, file "Android + Web/SVG/Light/Theme=Light, Show text=No, Shape=Square"). The button frame was removed and the mark rendered at 192 px with a clear background. It is not redrawn. Use it only for Google sign-in, as Google's branding guidelines allow.
- `opay_logo.svg`: OPay's official logo (wordmark), unchanged, from OPay's own website: https://gstatic.opayweb.com/website-ng/img/opay-logo.684aa98.svg (linked from https://www.opayweb.com).
- `opay_mark.svg`: the same file with only the viewBox changed so the ring symbol on its left fills a square tile. It is cropped, not redrawn.
- `zap_icon.png`: the app icon of "Zap by Paystack" (seller: Paystack Payments Limited), from Apple's public App Store lookup (app id 6463129864), resized to 256 px.
These show students which way they are paying (OPay, Zap) in our payment list and loading screen, as payment pages do. They are not changed, and are used only for that.
